_comments.source: Ported from scripts/cms_db.py (RELEVANT_CMS_SPECIALTIES, RELEVANT_TAXONOMIES, TARGET_HCPCS) and scripts/fetch_authors.py (SEARCH_QUERIES) as of 2026-04-05.
_comments.hcpcs_rationale: 27096 is the most specific code (SI joint/piriformis injection). Trigger-point and peripheral nerve blocks capture providers doing the general class of MSK injections. Nerve conduction studies (95907-95913) catch the electrodiagnostic workup. 76942/77003 are imaging guidance often billed alongside.
_comments.taxonomy_rationale: PM&R, Neurology, Ortho, Neurosurg, Sports Med, Anesth-Pain, and Interventional Radiology cover the physician types who diagnose/treat deep-gluteal/sciatic-compression conditions.
_comments.pubmed_rationale: 11 queries casting a wide net around piriformis anatomy, symptoms (sciatica), and treatments (injection, surgery, botox).
